bio: A new recruit posted to watch the roadside grave nobody will name, who has started hearing the streaks move at night.
context_line: Tessaly stands watch over the unnamed grave and has noticed the thin streaks converge on it.
dialogue_hostile: Move along. Nothing here to read.
dialogue_warm: They're not on the map, the ones under here. The paymaster says there was no rout. The ground disagrees.
